metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace by Charalampos Kyfonidis

plugins.name: agent-step-toolkit
plugins.description: Build agent-step LangGraph projects and tools: bootstrap a new project (runner library + streaming CLI + scaffold + the required local sandbox service per sandbox-contract.md), define graph state once as a Zod schema (single source of truth for reducers + invoke-boundary validation, channel-completeness enforced at construction; agent-step 2.0.0), localize/override every runner-emitted summary via templated system messages, add domain tools (actions / executors / verifiers / controller hooks + invalidatesOnChange; executors request library-state transitions via typed effects) with sandbox extensions per backend, offer engine-owned one-shot bounded choices with turn-provenance locks, port an existing project onto agent-step, including read-tool patterns (native paginated reads via `pageable`, LLM-authored data analysis over fetched data), channel-handoff actions with orchestrator/specialized agent roles, completed/abandon/off_topic handbacks, and library-coordinated off-topic delegation via agent-step 2.0.0 (the bootstrap scaffold ships the channel middleware wire/streaming contract), upgrade downstream projects' vendored runner library (/pull-library), lay down the three-layer test methodology, and audit a channel middleware implementation against the wire/streaming/handoff contract.

plugins.name: langgraph-plugin
plugins.description: Run and debug LangGraph.js conversations: /run-langgraph-conversation executes a single- or multi-turn test conversation against the local dev server — finding the running instance that serves the project on any port before starting one — and captures the thread, with an opt-in raw SSE streaming capture (token/handoff/custom event order); /follow-langgraph-conversation investigates any thread end-to-end: locates the instance that OWNS the thread, inventories the available monitoring sources (dev-server checkpoint history, LangSmith traces incl. EU/self-hosted endpoints, process/container logs), reads handoff signals and step-batch tool envelopes, and produces root-cause analysis. Discovers ports, owning instances, graph ids, and LangSmith credentials/endpoint from the project's own config and the live environment (langgraph.json, dev script, docker-compose, .env, running processes/containers).
